prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is driving on a straight road. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: A child chasing a ball suddenly darts directly into the ego vehicle's path from the right shoulder, forcing an immediate evasive maneuver.
A cyclist, traveling normally on the shoulder, abruptly swerves back across the lane line, crossing the path of the straight-moving ego vehicle and forcing an emergency avoidance maneuver.
A cyclist unexpectedly drifts into the ego lane, crossing the solid line and requiring an abrupt swerve to avoid contact.
A motorcycle in the adjacent lane accelerates and weaves erratically across multiple lanes without signaling or adhering to traffic markings.
A motorcycle performs a sudden U-turn in the straight driving lane, blocking the path directly ahead with insufficient stopping distance.
